Question_text: Reactions between alkalis and acids are exothermic. The change in temperature when aqueous sodium hydroxide is added to dilute hydrochloric acid of known concentration can be used to determine the concentration of the alkali. P is 1.50mol/dm³ hydrochloric acid. Q is aqueous sodium hydroxide.
You are provided with solutions R and S. Carry out the following tests and record your observations in the table. You should test and name any gas evolved.
